summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The VictoryShares US 500 Volatility Wtd ETF (CFA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index of the largest US stocks by market cap, screened for positive earnings and weighted by volatility. CFA was launched on Jul 2, 2014 and is issued by VictoryShares.
infoTable: Nasdaq Victory U.S. Large Cap 500 Volatility Weighted Index

holdings.infoBox: CFA is an equity ETF with a total of 502 individual holdings. The top holdings are Berkshire Hathaway stock at 0.45%, Atmos Energy at 0.41%, WEC Energy Group at 0.40%, Evergy at 0.39%, and FirstEnergy at 0.39%.
